summary: Pain Map refactor regression (iteration 8) — frontend only. Primary focus: onboarding input focus retention after component extraction + hook dependency fixes. ALL requested flows PASS. (1) ONBOARDING FOCUS: Registered a fresh user, logged in via UI, PATCHed /api/auth/profile to clear phone + emergency_contact_phone, reloaded /, correctly redirected to /onboarding. Typed '9876543210' into onboarding-phone-input with keyboard.type delay=50ms — full value retained AND document.activeElement remained onboarding-phone-input. Same for onboarding-age-input ('42'), onboarding-emergency-name-input ('Dr Smith Jones'), onboarding-emergency-phone-input ('9876500001'). No remounting / focus loss observed. Form submit navigated to '/' with 'All set — welcome' toast. (2) NAVBAR (UserMenu + MobileDock): nav-user-menu-btn opens dropdown with nav-profile-btn (navigates /profile) and nav-logout-btn (logs out). Click-outside closes menu. (3) DASHBOARD (ProfileStrip + StatCards + DiaryCharts + DiaryList): Statistics header, Blood Type/Age/Emergency/Address cards, Saved checks/Average severity/Trend stat cards, both severity-trend and where-it-hurts-most charts, and Pain diary list all render with entries. (4) DIAGNOSTICS + CARE RELIEF (EmergencyAlert + ReliefVideos + MandalaBreathe): CHEST + Sharp + severity=10 => level=R, care-relief-section=true, mandala-breathe-section=true, emergency-alert-card=true. LIMB (body-map-region-ua0 upper arm) + Sharp + sev=10 => level=R, care-relief-section=true, mandala-breathe-section=FALSE (correctly gated by CALMING_REGIONS in /components/care/emergency.js), emergency-alert-card=true. (5) AI ASSISTANT (AiMessageList): floating-ai-assistant-toggle-btn visible when signed in, panel opens with welcome message, typed message 'What is a headache?' via ai-assistant-message-input + ai-assistant-send-btn returned a proper assistant reply (~500ms-8s). After logout, floating-ai-assistant-toggle-btn count=0 (correctly hidden). (6) /reviews, /profile, /dashboard, /onboarding, /login all load without console errors or page errors. 0 JS errors across entire run.
critical_code_review_comments: Onboarding.js correctly defines OnbInput as a module-level component (line 154, outside Onboarding default export). This is the fix that preserves input focus across re-renders — verified with keyboard typing at 50ms delay. Earlier iteration_7 noted this risk; the refactor has resolved it.
AiMessageList.js keys messages with `${m.role}-${i}` — index-based keys are OK here since messages are append-only, but if message editing/removal is added later, prefer stable UUIDs.

CareRelief uses body-map-region testid prefix 'body-map-region-' with short ids (ua0, kn0, sh0 etc). CALMING_REGIONS gating uses semantic names (upper_arm, knee…) via a mapping; verified live that ua0 (upper arm) hides mandala and chest/head/abd/back show it.

success_rate.frontend: 100% — onboarding focus (4/4 fields), navbar menu (open/close/profile/logout), dashboard sections (4/4 cards + 2 charts + diary list), diagnostics CHEST red+mandala, LIMB red+no-mandala, emergency alert on red, AI assistant send/receive, AI hidden after logout, 0 JS errors on 5 pages

rca of the issue: No bugs. Refactor-only release verified clean. Component extractions (UserMenu/MobileDock from Navbar, ProfileStrip/StatCards/DiaryCharts/DiaryList from Dashboard, EmergencyAlert/ReliefVideos/MandalaBreathe/emergency from CareRelief, AiMessageList from FloatingAIAssistant, bodyMapStyle from BodyMap) all render identical UX.
